visualCharacteristics: A section heading with a blue accent rule and optional intro text. Variants give a dotted guide title bar, centred or blue-block titles, numbered badges, smaller sizes, or a list link beside the heading.
contentPattern: Row 1: one cell with a heading (h2) and optional text paragraphs. Optional row 2 (with-link): a link paragraph shown as a button beside the heading.
usage: Use it to introduce a page section with a styled heading.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for styled section headings across templates; use a plain default-content heading when no decoration is needed.
